# EarnReward

> EarnReward (https://earn.javnex.in) is an audited micro-task web terminal for Indian users enabling fast task completion, zero-fee internal transfers, and fast bank cashouts.

## Platform Details
- **Website**: https://earn.javnex.in
- **Platform Type**: Micro-task rewards and zero-fee wallet pooling
- **Target Audience**: Indian users seeking legitimate task compensation
- **Compliance**: India Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023) and DPDP Rules 2025
- **Payout Methods**: Direct Bank Transfer (IMPS), Polygon USDT (with 6% exchange spread & TDS buffer)
- **Minimum Payout**: ₹100 INR

## Key Platform Features
- **Verified Micro-Tasks**: Complete simple online shop tasks and earn ₹10 to ₹25+ per verified task.
- **Zero-Fee Peer Transfers**: Transfer wallet credits to friends and family with ₹0 fees to pool funds toward withdrawal minimums.
- **Strict Anti-Spam Drip Velocity**: Organic pacing and single task limits to protect merchant listings from spam.
- **Transparent Ledger**: Cryptographically sound internal double-entry balances with public payout tracking.

## Core Legal & Regulatory Documents
- [Privacy Policy](https://earn.javnex.in/privacy): DPDP Act 2023 compliant statutory notice detailing data processing, retention, user rights, and contact details.
- [Terms of Service](https://earn.javnex.in/terms): Platform governance, one task per shop rule, anti-bot rules, and withdrawal guidelines.
- [Payout & Refund Policy](https://earn.javnex.in/refund): Withdrawal minimums, 6% cash-out fee buffers, and bank IMPS disbursement rules.
- [Grievance Redressal](https://earn.javnex.in/grievance): Data Protection Officer contact and statutory grievance submission portal.
